Total cooked food ≈ 57 g. Sauce or oil: none visible beyond a light sheen, so none added.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer visible on the plate; the plate centre shows bare white surface around the cluster. No hidden items added.

- Browned meat chunks (cooked, moderate fat): ~200 kcal/100 g.
